title: Finite generation through a shifted-quadrant spectral sequence
statement: Let $A$ be a commutative Noetherian ring [def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring], and let $a,b\in\mathbf Z$. Let $E=(E_s^{p,q},d_s)_{s\geq2}$ be a cohomological spectral sequence of $A$-modules [def-sp-spectral-sequence], indexed by $p,q\in\mathbf Z$, with $A$-linear differentials $d_s:E_s^{p,q}\to E_s^{p+s,q-s+1}$ and the specified isomorphisms from the homology of page $s$ to page $s+1$. Suppose every $E_2^{p,q}$ is finitely generated [def-weil-finitely-generated-module] and $E_2^{p,q}=0$ whenever $p<a$ or $q<b$. Then every page is supported in $p\geq a$, $q\geq b$ and has finitely generated terms. For each $(p,q)$ its incoming and outgoing differentials are zero for every integer $s\geq2$ satisfying $s>\max(p-a,q-b+1)$, so the page identifications yield an eventual stable term $E_\infty^{p,q}$; every such term is finitely generated. If $T^n$ ($n\in\mathbf Z$) are $A$-modules equipped with finite exhaustive separated decreasing filtrations [def-sp-filtration] and $A$-linear isomorphisms $F^pT^n/F^{p+1}T^n\cong E_\infty^{p,n-p}$ for all $p,n$, then each $T^n$ is finitely generated and $T^n=0$ for $n<a+b$.

source.place: Tag 0D0C, lemma-coherent-internal-hom, proof: the algebra problem and the two displayed Ext spectral sequences.

proof.text: Induct on $s\geq2$ for support. The base is the hypothesis. By [def-sp-spectral-sequence], $E_{s+1}^{p,q}$ is isomorphic to $\ker(d_s^{p,q})/\operatorname{im}(d_s^{p-s,q+s-1})$. If $p<a$ or $q<b$, its middle page term is zero by induction, so its kernel and this quotient are zero. This proves support on every page.

source.place: Tag 0D0C, lemma-coherent-internal-hom, proof, final finite-generation inference from the two convergent Ext spectral sequences; expanded using homology.tex definition-spectral-sequence and algebra.tex Tag 00FP(2).

proof.text: Induct on $s\geq2$ for finite generation, starting with the assumed $E_2$ terms. By [lem-trf-noetherian-submodule-finitely-presented], $\ker(d_s^{p,q})\subseteq E_s^{p,q}$ is finitely generated, since $A$ is Noetherian. The images of a finite generating set generate its quotient by the incoming image: every class is the same linear combination of the generator classes. The page isomorphism of [def-sp-spectral-sequence] takes these generators to generators of $E_{s+1}^{p,q}$, in the sense of [def-weil-finitely-generated-module].

source.place: Tag 0D0C, lemma-coherent-internal-hom, proof, final finite-generation inference from the two convergent Ext spectral sequences; expanded using homology.tex definition-spectral-sequence and algebra.tex Tag 00FP(2).

proof.text: Fix $(p,q)$. If $s>\max(p-a,q-b+1)$, the incoming source has $p-s<a$ and the outgoing target has $q-s+1<b$, hence both differentials are zero by Step 1. Thus the page isomorphism identifies $E_{s+1}^{p,q}$ with $E_s^{p,q}/0$. Take $s_0=\max(2,p-a+1,q-b+2)$ and define $E_\infty^{p,q}=E_{s_0}^{p,q}$; compositions of these specified page identifications identify every later term with it. It is finite by Step 2 and vanishes outside the quadrant by Step 1.

source.place: Tag 0D0C, lemma-coherent-internal-hom, proof, final finite-generation inference from the two convergent Ext spectral sequences; expanded using homology.tex definition-spectral-sequence and algebra.tex Tag 00FP(2).

proof.text: Fix $n$. Finiteness of [def-sp-filtration] gives integers $l\leq h$ with $F^lT^n=T^n$ and $F^hT^n=0$. Descend from $h$ to $l$. At step $p$, the quotient $F^pT^n/F^{p+1}T^n\cong E_\infty^{p,n-p}$ has finite generators by Step 3. Choose lifts in $F^pT^n$ and adjoin finite generators of $F^{p+1}T^n$ already obtained by induction. For any $x\in F^pT^n$, subtract the linear combination of those lifts representing its quotient class; the difference belongs to $F^{p+1}T^n$. This finite union therefore generates $F^pT^n$ by [def-weil-finitely-generated-module]. The base zero module has the empty generating set. At $l$ this proves that $T^n$ is finite.

source.place: Tag 0D0C, lemma-coherent-internal-hom, proof, final finite-generation inference from the two convergent Ext spectral sequences; expanded using homology.tex definition-spectral-sequence and algebra.tex Tag 00FP(2).

proof.text: If $n<a+b$, no integer $p$ satisfies both $p\geq a$ and $n-p\geq b$. Consequently every graded piece in Step 4 is zero. A zero quotient $F^pT^n/F^{p+1}T^n$ means $F^pT^n=F^{p+1}T^n$. Induction along the finite interval from $h$ to $l$ gives $T^n=F^lT^n=F^hT^n=0$.
